derivedFrom: docs/research/FORMAT-gemini.md (source tag v0.68.0, section 10 synthetic example), extended by hand to cover each mapped record type
note: No file here comes from a real Gemini CLI session. Paths, ids, hashes and text are invented. Hostile files are hand-written to probe the adapters.

session-golden.jsonl.purpose: golden: header, re-appended message ids, $set, $patch, $rewindTo, functionResponse carriers, thoughts, tokens, tool statuses, info/error/warning, unknown record

session-header-only.jsonl.purpose: header-only session; must not collide with chat-json

session-legacy.json.purpose: golden: legacy single ConversationRecord document, pretty printed

hostile-content.jsonl.purpose: HTML, ANSI/OSC, bidi, __proto__, secret-shaped strings, odd types and keys

hostile-wrong-types.jsonl.purpose: wrong value types in every mapped field, non-object records, $set.messages checkpoint

hostile-legacy-messages-wrong-type.json.purpose: legacy document whose /messages is not an array
